name: agent-lab-evals
description: Local-only Promptfoo regression suites for Agent Lab

scripts.validate: NODE_OPTIONS='--require=./fixtures/node-keepalive.cjs' PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 promptfoo validate config -c promptfooconfig.yaml
scripts.eval:fast: NODE_OPTIONS='--require=./fixtures/node-keepalive.cjs' PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --filter-metadata suite=fast --max-concurrency 1 --no-cache --no-share --no-write
scripts.eval:full: NODE_OPTIONS='--require=./fixtures/node-keepalive.cjs' PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --max-concurrency 1 --no-cache --no-share --no-write
scripts.test:bad-fixture: sh -c 'if NODE_OPTIONS="--require=./fixtures/node-keepalive.cjs" PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 promptfoo eval -c fixtures/bad-assertion-config.yaml --max-concurrency 1 --no-cache --no-share --no-write; then echo "ERROR: deliberately bad response unexpectedly passed" >&2; exit 1; else echo "PASS: deliberately bad response was rejected by the equals assertion"; fi'
